function solve(x, width)
    if width <= 0
        throw(ArgumentError("width must be positive"))
    end
    n = length(x)
    if width > n
        return Float64[]
    end
    
    result = Vector{Union{Float64, Missing}}(undef, n - width + 1)
    
    for i in 1:(n - width + 1)
        window = x[i:i+width-1]
        non_missing = [v for v in window if !ismissing(v)]
        if isempty(non_missing)
            result[i] = missing
        else
            result[i] = sum(non_missing) / length(non_missing)
        end
    end
    
    return result
end
